tasks.label: Verify real Gemini automatic reconnect
tasks.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {WebSocket} from "./gemini-live-test/node_modules/ws/wrapper.mjs"; import {LiveService} from "./gemini-live-test/live-service.mjs"; class Socket {static OPEN=1; constructor(url){this.raw=new WebSocket(url,{origin:"https://www.daynize.co.kr",headers:{host:"api.daynize.co.kr"}});this.raw.on("open",()=>this.onopen?.());this.raw.on("message",data=>this.onmessage?.({data:data.toString()}));this.raw.on("error",()=>this.onerror?.());this.raw.on("close",code=>this.onclose?.({code}));}get readyState(){return this.raw.readyState;}get bufferedAmount(){return this.raw.bufferedAmount;}send(value){this.raw.send(value);}close(code,reason){this.raw.close(code,reason);}} const service=new LiveService({endpoint:"ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws/gemini-live",WebSocketClass:Socket,retryDelay:1000,timeout:15000});let connections=0;let session;let first;const deadline=setTimeout(()=>{console.error("Real reconnect probe timeout");service.stop();process.exitCode=1;},25000);service.addEventListener("error",event=>{console.error(event.detail.message);clearTimeout(deadline);service.stop();process.exitCode=1;});service.addEventListener("connectionstate",event=>{console.log(JSON.stringify(event.detail));if(event.detail.state!=="CONNECTED")return;connections++;if(connections===1){session=service.sessionId;first=service.socket;setTimeout(()=>first.raw.terminate(),1000);}else{assert.equal(service.sessionId,session);assert.notEqual(service.socket,first);assert.equal(service.sendAudio("AAA="),true);console.log("PASS: real Gemini setup restored after forced disconnect, same session ID, audio send enabled");clearTimeout(deadline);service.stop();}});await service.start().catch(()=>{});'
